job: Designing toolset and capability defaults for an open-source or commercial coding-agent framework as autonomy and tool count grow
outcome: A shipped harness release that boots with a least-privilege, default-off toolset that the user must explicitly enable per capability
motivation: An agent wired to browser, code-exec, MCP and shell by default is an unaudited liability; gating it is the cheapest safe default

task.who: the framework's agent-runtime and security maintainers
task.what: Add a default-deny toolset gating mode to the harness
task.where: The open-source or product coding-agent framework codebase
task.why: Default-on tool access is a large unaudited attack surface
task.how: Per-tool opt-in gating durably pinned against silent re-enable

job: Drafting and publishing security baselines for autonomous LLM agents as default-on tool access emerges as a recognized risk class
outcome: A published agent-security guideline that names least-privilege or default-deny toolset gating as a recommended baseline control
motivation: Codifying a concrete, workable mitigation gives the field a citable standard and pressures harnesses to adopt it by default

task.who: standards-body, OWASP-style, or vendor security-research authors
task.what: Recommend default-deny toolset gating as a baseline control
task.where: A published agent-security framework, standard, or guidance doc
task.why: The field needs a citable baseline for safe agent tool access
task.how: Least-privilege per-tool gating written into the recommended baseline

job: Setting deployment requirements for coding agents inside the org, demanding scoped tool access before approving any autonomous harness
outcome: Procurement and platform requirements that force harness vendors to ship default-deny, explicitly-gated toolsets out of the box
motivation: Auditability and blast-radius limits are non-negotiable for production agents; default-on tool access fails internal security review

task.who: enterprise platform and AppSec security leads
task.what: Require scoped, default-off tool access for deployed agents
task.where: Internal agent-deployment policy and vendor procurement requirements
task.why: Default-on agent tool access fails internal security review
task.how: Make per-tool gating a deployment and procurement gate
